title: VectorAI Website & User Interface Operations Guide
description: Consolidated UI documentation covering Dashboard KPIs, Machine Inspector subtabs, Accelerated Wear simulation, Prediction curves, Maintenance Dispatch modal, and Technical Document viewers.

sections.title: Real-Time Factory Health & Operational Metrics
sections.content: The top of the Dashboard displays high-level factory telemetry KPI cards: 1. Overall Factory Health Score (weighted average health of all active machines); 2. Fleet Status Breakdown (counts of Healthy, Warning, Critical, and Maintenance machines); 3. Average Fleet RUL (remaining operational hours across all running equipment); 4. Critical Alert Counter (active unacknowledged threshold alarms).

sections.title: Interactive Machine Overview & Quick Navigation
sections.content: The central section contains the live Machine Telemetry Grid/Table, listing every equipment node (DIC-001, DA-001, WB-001, MOLD-001, ATE-001, etc.). Each row presents the machine status badge, real-time health score, current RUL hours, operational hours since baseline, and primary sensor readings. Clicking any machine row opens the comprehensive Machine Detail view.

sections.title: Synchronized Plant Telemetry Event Timeline
sections.content: The Dashboard features a real-time System Event Log showing the latest telemetry events, automated warning/critical state transitions, dynamic process rerouting alerts, and maintenance completions. Events update live every 3 seconds alongside the simulation ticker.

sections.title: Multi-Criteria Machine Filtering & Search
sections.content: The Machines tab top toolbar provides multi-dimensional filtering: Filter by Machine Status (All, Healthy, Warning, Critical, Maintenance, Offline), Filter by Machine Type (Wafer Dicing, Die Attacher, Wire Bonder, Molding, IC Tester), Free-text search by ID/Name/Location, View mode toggle (Card Grid vs Table List), and bulk status summary pills.

sections.title: Six Dedicated Machine Detail Subtabs
sections.content: Selecting a machine opens the Machine Detail view featuring 6 specialized subtabs: 1. Overview (high-level health score, operational status, RUL summary, and interactive wear simulation controls); 2. Sensors (live continuous telemetry meters with normal/warning/critical gauge visualizers); 3. Anomalies (active threshold violations, severity badges, and diagnostic recommendations); 4. Prediction (detailed RUL parameter decomposition and multi-sensor degradation graphs); 5. Maintenance (scheduled work orders, service history, and technician dispatch); 6. Documents (authoritative PDF manual viewer and knowledge sync status).

sections.title: Real-Time Fast-Forward Wear Simulation Controls
sections.content: The Machine Overview subtab provides an interactive 'Simulate Accelerated Wear' toggle button. Enabling accelerated wear fast-forwards mechanical/electrical degradation at 60x real-time speed, allowing operators and engineers to observe live threshold crossings, anomaly triggering, and automated dynamic rerouting in real time.

sections.title: Remaining Useful Life Hours & Reliability Rating
sections.content: The Prediction interface displays the calculated RUL in hours, converted into estimated operating days and maintenance windows. It shows the overall Degradation Percentage, Remaining Life Ratio, Base Useful Life specification, and the Model Reliability status ('HIGH', 'MEDIUM', 'LOW') based on sensor stream completeness.

sections.title: Explainable Multi-Sensor Parameter Breakdown
sections.content: The Prediction view provides a transparent parameter contribution matrix. For each model sensor, it shows: Current Value vs Healthy/Critical Limits, Model Weight percentage, Individual Degradation score (0.0 to 1.0), and Percentage Share of Total Wear. This gives maintenance teams complete visibility into exactly which mechanical component is driving machine degradation.

sections.title: Multi-Sensor Degradation Trajectory Curves
sections.content: The interactive SVG DegradationChart plots continuous historical telemetry trends against warning and critical thresholds. It projects future degradation trajectories based on current wear rates, allowing engineers to visualize exactly when a sensor is projected to violate safety limits.

sections.title: Scheduled Service Matrix & Preventive Maintenance Pipeline
sections.content: The Maintenance Tab aggregates all preventive and predictive maintenance tasks across the facility. It features an interactive Service Calendar and Gantt-style matrix tracking scheduled maintenance windows, upcoming technician assignments, and cumulative machine operating hours.

sections.title: Technician Work Order Dispatch Interface
sections.content: Clicking 'Dispatch Technician' opens the Dispatch Modal. The modal displays: 1. Machine Identification & Cleanroom Zone; 2. Diagnostic Summary & Triggering Anomaly; 3. Live Sensor Telemetry Snapshot at time of dispatch; 4. Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) Action Checklist; 5. Communication Channel selector (Email, SMS, Webhook) with live notification preview.

sections.title: Service Completion Logging & Historical Records
sections.content: The Maintenance Tab includes a completed service log recording date, technician, machine ID, replaced components, downtime duration, and post-service sensor verification readings, providing a fully auditable compliance record.

sections.title: Authoritative Model Knowledge Synchronization Status
sections.content: The Machine Documents subtab displays a 'Domain Knowledge Extraction Status' banner confirming that the machine's authoritative specification has been extracted, validated, and synchronized into VectorAI's internal intelligence engine. It summarizes the extracted sensor thresholds, preventive maintenance intervals, failure scenarios, and deterministic RUL parameters.

sections.title: Direct PDF Technical Manual Preview & Download
sections.content: The subtab presents the authoritative equipment technical manual (e.g. High-Speed Thermo-Sonic Wire Bonder Technical Manual PDF). Users can view the complete PDF in a dedicated embedded viewer or open/download the manual in a new browser tab for offline maintenance reference.

sections.title: Document Revisions and Cleanroom Specifications
sections.content: Each document card lists the manual ID (e.g. VAI-MAN-WB-001), document revision (v1.0), release date, synthetic prototype disclaimer, and associated tags, ensuring operators reference the exact approved version for the machinery on the factory floor.
